newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.
newsitem.headline: Austria cenbank calls for repo bids, rates steady.

text.p: The Austrian central bank on Thursday called for bids on two-week securities repurchase agreements at an unchanged rate at 3.0 percent and said it would leave its key interest rates unchanged.
Bids have to be in by 1000 GMT on Friday, it said.
Last week, the bank allotted 7.71 billion schillings in repos, filling six percent of bids.
Austria's discount rate stands at 2.5 percent, its Lombard emergency borrowing rate at 4.75 percent and its Gomex money market rate at 3.4 percent. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
